en: Where do you leave the light?
Move with A / D or the arrow keys.
Drag on the left side of the screen to walk.
Use the arrow buttons to walk.
Press Space to jump. Hold it to jump higher.
Tap the right side of the screen to jump.
Press the jump button. Hold it to jump higher.
Faint platforms are only solid inside the lantern's light.
Press E to set the lantern down. Walk into it to pick it up.
Swipe down on the right side to set the lantern down. Walk into it to pick it up.
Press the lantern button to set it down. Walk into it to pick it up.
Hold Shift to raise the light. It reaches further, but burns oil three times faster.
Hold the right side of the screen to raise the light. It reaches further, but burns oil three times faster.
Hold the sun button to raise the light. It reaches further, but burns oil three times faster.
The lantern sinks through faint platforms and lights them from below. Walk into it to take it back.
Light makes faint walls solid too. Leave the lantern behind to slip through.
Set the lantern where it lights your way up, but not the lid above.
Your lantern is somewhere ahead. Find it in the dark.
The dark tide is coming. Run!
The light shrinks as the oil burns. Blue flasks refill it.
Stay out of the light too long and the darkness closes in.
Shrines refill your oil. If you fall, you return to the last one.
Shadows only move while you are in the dark. Light drives them back.
